results.title: Best-price deal: Pirate RPG with tons of loot and builds now just around $2
results.description: Deal | Rum & Gun is a pirate-themed action RPG that promises plenty of loot, diverse character builds and a healthy dose of pirate humor. The game is currently available on Steam for just $2.49, matching its previous all-time low.
